name: app-white-benefits-cards-on-curved-path-with-app-icon-root
title: Benefit Cards on a Curved Path from the App Icon
whatItIs: A pale page with an app icon at the top from which a dashed and solid curved path descends past four tilted white cards (Accessibility, Engagement, Support, UX/UI), each with an icon, a short description and an indigo check badge.
whatItMeans: Cards hanging along a flowing path feel like a journey of outcomes, and check badges confirm each goal.
techniques: Flowing line bundle from an icon down the page
Tilted cards alternating left and right
Indigo check badge on each card corner
Faint giant logo shape as a background
Soft shadows for a floating feel

vocabulary.definition: Several parallel lines curving together as a route.
A small circle with a tick marking completion.
A card with a soft shadow that appears to hover.
